subject: general
question: Which Buddhist council was held during the time of Ashoka?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Third.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The 3rd Buddhist council was held in 250 BC.
 
 
• Venue: Ashoka Rama Vihar, Patliputra__
 
• Chairman: Moggaliputta Tissa
 
• __Patron: Ashoka (Maurya Dynasty)__
 
• Result: (i) Compilation of Mahavibhasa Sastra (ii) the division of Buddhists into Hinayanists.
